id: \bTucker: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle me.
en: \bTucker: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle me.
it: \bTucker: Ti servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarmi.

id: \bTucker: Welcome to the Battle Dome. Isn't it just lovely?
en: \bTucker: Welcome to the Battle Dome. Isn't it just lovely?
it: \bTucker: Benvenuto alla Cupola Lotta. Non è semplicemente splendida?

id: \bDo you hear it? This crowd! They're all itching to see our match! Ahahah! I bet you're twitching all over from the tension of getting to battle me!
en: \bDo you hear it? This crowd! They're all itching to see our match! Ahahah! I bet you're twitching all over from the tension of getting to battle me!
it: \bLo senti? Questo pubblico! Non vedono l'ora di assistere al nostro incontro! Ahahah! Scommetto che fremi dalla tensione all'idea di sfidarmi!
\bTucker: Ti sei meritato il Simbolo Tattica.

id: \bI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Pike. It's located near Fuchsia City inside the Safari Zone.
en: \bI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Pike.  It's located near Fuchsia City inside the Safari Zone.
it: \bTi consiglio di andare alla Serpe Lotta come prossima tappa.  Si trova vicino a Fucsiapoli, dentro la Zona Safari.
